column1: # Any rule not listed here keeps ZAP's default baseline behaviour (WARN),
# which never fails the scan. The 2 rules below are the ones this project
# actually cares about — Spec S00's whole reason to exist is proving COOP/COEP
# isolation (see ADR-S00-02) — so they double as a real regression gate: they
# pass today because vite.config.ts's `preview.headers` mirrors the real
# public/_headers Cloudflare config, and they're exactly what the PR canhoto
# will strip to prove this gate bites.
